commits.author: Bs Mahi
commits.message:
Update Spring Boot to 4.1.1

This change updates all project examples and docs from Spring Boot 4.1.0 to 4.1.1 to align with the current dependency version. It also removes the Spring milestone repository from Gradle/Spring Security examples, and updates the README note to clarify that Spring Boot 4.x requires Java 17+.

commits.message:
Upgraded Spring Boot to 4.1.0

Upgrade spring-boot-starter-parent from 4.0.6 to 4.1.0 across numerous Maven modules and documentation files. Also update org.springframework.boot plugin versions in Gradle builds to 4.1.0 and bump Gradle wrapper distributions to 9.5.1, adding wrapper properties (networkTimeout, retries, retryBackOffMs, validateDistributionUrl) to align build tooling with the Spring Boot upgrade.
